metadata.analyzer: Injected independent referenceTokens: original Unicode token spans, NFKC then lowercase; no stemming/stop words.
metadata.arrays: Original values joined with newline within each field because upstream exact filter ignores string[]; lexical membership only, no phrase/value-boundary equivalence.
metadata.matching: Single-token exact/prefix only; tolerance0. Orama3.1.18 exact adds case-sensitive original-string word filter; every row requires complete membership validation, Unicode/case differences are Not comparable.
metadata.ranking: Foreign native relevance/order, not Raveldex BM25/score/tie equivalence.
metadata.output: Complete foreign hits include retained source documents/scores; adapter maps IDs and checks count. No equivalent output-cost claim.
metadata.retainedSource: Orama document store retains original selected field values with newline-joined array values; no cross-value phrase contract.
metadata.updates: Not comparable: no atomic native revision/sidecar/cancellation contract.
